entities.summary: Werner Hans Frederik Abrahamson Læssøe (1811–1850) was a Danish officer known for his service in the First Schleswig War. He was the son of Margrethe Juliane Signe Læssøe and the brother of the priest Kristian Frederik Læssøe, the painter Thorald Læssøe and the numismatist Ludvig Læssøe.

entities.name: Frederik Læssøe
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Werner Hans Frederik Abrahamson Læssøe (1811–1850) was a Danish officer known for his service in the First Schleswig War. He was the son of Margrethe Juliane Signe Læssøe and the brother of the priest Kristian Frederik Læssøe, the painter Thorald Læssøe and the numismatist Ludvig Læssøe.
